queryText: How many vacation days do employees get?
What is the process for requesting time off?
Can unused vacation days be carried over?
answer: No, typically excess vacation time cannot be rolled over to the next year according to standard corporate policies; it is usually paid out in cash when an employee leaves the company or if no use was made before a specified deadline.

queryText: Compare vacation policies for full-time vs part-time employees
answer: Full-time employees are typically entitled to a standard number of paid leave days, while the allocation may be prorated or unpaid for part-time staff based on their work hours. Some companies offer additional vacation accruals per hour worked over a certain threshold exclusively to full-timers.
